content_md:
I don't know if y'all remember, but coding with Claude & ChatGPT 18 months ago was terrible

You'd use up your quota quickly

Spend multiple cycles troubleshooting problems of the AI's own making

Truly frustrating while also being liberating and fueling creativity

The shape of AI today is unrecognizable from that period

It's truly unbelievable how quickly you can build things in software now
